observations: Black cylindrical wireless speaker with fabric grille and rubber end caps.
"JEALOT" embossed on the side and on the end-cap grille.
Top control panel with power, EQ, mode, play/pause, and volume buttons.
Fabric shoulder strap with metal swivel hooks attached to both ends.
In photo 2, the speaker lies on a marble-patterned floor next to a white power strip and charging cables.
No visible cracks or major exterior damage.
